summary: The acceptance candidate preserves the reviewed biologically plausible morphology classes in the comparative technical-valid population and does not use WT morphology as an acceptance or tuning target. Technical failures require invalid geometry, leakage, ROI violations, unrecoverable tracking inconsistency, or objective multi-object evidence. Reports use biological specimens as independent units, identify the pilot as insufficient for genotype inference, and describe repeated-ROI volume only as sampled volume. No blocking biological-validity mismatch was identified.

findings.title: Biological conclusions remain outside the validated claim
findings.impact: The evidence validates production semantics and internal consistency, but cannot establish segmentation accuracy against biological truth, distinguish every short track from optical tips/fragments/noise, or establish a KJ-versus-WT biological effect.
evidence: V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:83 states the results are from one specimen per group and are not genotype inference.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/report/02_quality_control/source_files/specimen_group_comparison_qc.json records one independent specimen per group and suppresses inference.

findings.recommendation: Require blinded manual-mask comparison or another independent ground-truth dataset for segmentation accuracy claims, at least three independent specimens per group before inferential output, and external biological validation before mechanistic or genotype-effect conclusions.

limitations: Focused tests could not be rerun because the read-only environment had no writable temporary directory; confidence therefore relies partly on inspected test definitions and the committed validation receipt.

Image and tracking evidence is bound to production-code commit 3a62520b1cfd92a66c060e92df683eb1ab933442. The inspected diff to reviewed commit 366fc22eb53df812dd3f162eb26cdbab46b66b61 adds audit/evidence artifacts and does not modify the production pipeline, tuner, profile, or tests.
Only one KJ and one WT specimen are represented; biological group effects are unvalidated.
Automated morphology labels cannot conclusively distinguish genuine short nuclei, optical tips, fragmentation, noise, or fusion without manual masks or external biological validation.
Apparent body width and observed-slice mask volume remain segmentation-, focus-, and PSF-sensitive proxies rather than deconvolved anatomical dimensions.
recommended_follow_up: Run the focused adversarial tests in a writable validated environment and attach the command result to a superseding receipt if independent execution evidence is required.
Validate segmentation and split/merge behavior against blinded manual instance masks spanning both genotypes and the full morphology range.
Acquire at least three independent biological specimens per group before enabling inferential comparisons; larger groups are preferable for stable effect estimates.
Use slice-specific 3D organ masks if anatomical seminal-vesicle or whole-organ volume becomes a future claim.
